import bpy
rig = bpy.data.objects['Cultivator · 8 directions']
rig.animation_data_create()
rig.animation_data.action = bpy.data.actions['run']
rig.rotation_euler.z = 0
bpy.context.scene.frame_start = 1
bpy.context.scene.frame_end = 12
bpy.context.scene.frame_set(4)
for obj in bpy.context.selected_objects:
    obj.select_set(False)
rig.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = rig
for area in bpy.context.screen.areas:
    if area.type == 'VIEW_3D':
        area.spaces.active.region_3d.view_perspective = 'CAMERA'
        area.spaces.active.shading.type = 'MATERIAL'
print({'action':rig.animation_data.action.name,'frame':bpy.context.scene.frame_current,'left_leg':list(rig.pose.bones['leg.L'].rotation_euler),'right_leg':list(rig.pose.bones['leg.R'].rotation_euler)})
